meta.title: Digitus — Software & AI for your organization
meta.desc: Digitus: software and AI solutions for education, the public sector and companies across the Dominican Republic and LATAM.
hero.pill: AI-powered software, built in the Dominican Republic
hero.lead: Digitus designs, builds and deploys software and AI solutions for education, the public sector and private companies across the Dominican Republic and Latin America.
hero.s3: From Santo Domingo to the region
svc.h2: From concept to production, with AI at the core.
svc.p: One partner to build, deploy and scale your software, your cloud and your digital strategy.
svc.ai.d: Agents, assistants and automations powered by language models and connected to your data and workflows: customer service, document analysis, sales and operations.
svc.ai.x1: Assistants and agents connected to your documents and systems (RAG).
svc.ai.x2: Customer service automation over WhatsApp, web and email.
svc.ai.x3: Document extraction and analysis with OCR and AI.
svc.dev.d: Custom web and mobile platforms with user-centered design and continuous delivery.
svc.dev.x2: Web and mobile apps, APIs and integrations.
svc.dep.d: We take your software and AI models to production with serverless architectures, CI/CD and monitoring.
svc.dep.x3: Monitoring, alerting and MLOps for AI models.
svc.dx.d: We digitize processes, integrate systems and guide your team through adoption.
svc.mkt.d: AI-powered digital marketing: content, campaigns, SEO and analytics that convert.
svc.cloud.d: Web hosting, AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Workspace: migration, management and support.
svc.cloud.x1: Migration and management on AWS and Azure.
svc.cloud.x2: Email and collaboration with Google Workspace.
svc.cloud.x3: Web hosting, domains and ongoing support.
ai.p: Every project starts with one question: where can artificial intelligence save time, cut costs or open new opportunities? Then we build it and ship it.
ai.s1.d: We identify AI use cases with measurable impact on your operations.
ai.s2.d: Validated in weeks with your real data and your team.
ai.s3.d: Robust software with privacy and data governance by design.
ai.s4.d: Live in production, measured and continuously improving.
sec.h2: Solutions for those who move the region forward.
sec.p: We work with institutions and companies across the Dominican Republic and LATAM, understanding their context, language and culture.
sec.edu.d: Learning platforms, AI tutors and academic management.
sec.gov.d: Digital citizen services, online procedures and virtual assistants.
sec.priv.d: Automation, analytics and applied AI for large organizations.
sec.smb.d: Accessible tools to sell more and operate better.
rd.h2: World-class technology, built for your reality.
rd.p: We bring artificial intelligence and modern software to institutions and businesses, close by, in your language and at your pace.
why.1.d: We design with artificial intelligence from day one, not as an add-on.
why.2.d: A registered Dominican company with a local team that knows your market.
why.3.d: Serverless, secure and cost-efficient: pay only for what you use.
why.4.d: Product, documentation and support in Spanish and English.
ct.h2: Let's build your next AI solution.
ct.p: Tell us about your challenge. We reply within one business day.
ct.loc: Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic · Serving all of LATAM
